title: Correct current calculation
description: Essential: Student must compute the current using Ohm's law for the complete circuit, obtaining I = E/(R+r) = 4 A.

title: Correct magnetic force balance
description: Essential: Student must state the final magnetic induction strength B = 0.25 T from the force equilibrium condition.

title: Apply Ampere's force law
description: Important: Student must correctly relate the magnetic force on the rod to the current, length, and magnetic field (F_mag = BIL).

title: Apply Hooke's law for springs
description: Important: Student must relate the change in spring elongation to the change in force (ΔF = 2kΔx, factor of 2 for two springs).

title: Unit conversion consistency
description: Important: Student must correctly convert given lengths (cm to m) and other quantities to SI units in calculations.

title: Force direction analysis
description: Optional: Student may use the left-hand rule to justify the direction of magnetic force and its effect on spring elongation.

title: Incorrect force balance equation
description: Pitfall: Student omits the factor of 2 for the two springs or misidentifies the forces (e.g., ignores gravity's cancellation).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Student makes a sign error in force direction or a unit conversion error (e.g., treating 0.2 cm as 0.2 m).
